excerpts:
# ENCOUNTER_END Payload Issue
WoW Classic WoW Classic Bug Report
[Rylak-3034442](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Rylak-3034442) (Rylak) February 10, 2020, 8:05am 1
I maintain and develop an addon for which part of the functionality requires detection of boss kills. I’ve noticed that with the ENCOUNTER_END event on non-English clients, part of the payload appears to be missing information.
While troubleshooting an issue where a boss kill was not detected with a player using a zhCN client, I examined their etrace and found the ENCOUNTER_END entry. I found that arg 2 returned "* instead of the boss name.
This issue doesn’t appear to be occurring on enUS or enGB clients but I suspect that it is occurring on ruRU clients as I have had users reporting the exact same behaviour on that locale.
